constraint: inspectContentPack sorts ordered lexical references by position and concatenates target.label. It does not apply reference.transformation before comparing normalized sentence text. Thus a base あらう reference with path polite cannot import a sentence labelled てをあらいます.
scope: Import validation only; this is not a claim that runtime audio or transformation selection lacks support.
authoringPolicy: New authored Japanese examples must import with complete visible lexical constituents. Do not create hidden duplicate lexical inflections or weaken validation. Preserve existing inflected examples and all transformation sets/recordings. Reassess the constraint against a newer host before authoring selected-form sentence references.
householdDisposition: Only unpublished household candidates were revised before first publication. No previously published inflected example was replaced. The four household verbs retain all 32 grammatical-form recordings.
